AC-001.assertion: Format-preservation predicate is checked by the JSON, CSV, UTF-8 text, and SQLite baseline Battle cases and their functional-judge receipts.

AC-002.assertion: Policy-value removal predicate is checked across every required acceptance-floor representation case with no-data-leak Judge evidence.

AC-003.assertion: Stable replacement and non-collision predicate is checked by cross-format same-identity and formatted-phone numeric alias cases.

AC-004.assertion: Protected/non-sensitive preservation predicate is checked by external Docker brief-contract and verify receipts; Battle baseline cases exercise surrounding benign data preservation.

AC-005.assertion: CSV/JSON/SQLite structural preservation predicate is checked by format baseline cases plus SQLite TEXT/INTEGER/REAL cases and functional-judge evidence.

AC-006.assertion: Complete-release-boundary verification predicate is checked by the full acceptance-floor replay and external spec-derived/Docker oracle receipts.

AC-007.assertion: Release/log boundary predicate is checked by Battle no-leak Judge evidence and external release-boundary scan receipts.

AC-008.assertion: Fail-closed predicate is checked by invalid/ambiguous numeric and SQLite schema cases that must reject rather than release unsafe output.

AC-009.assertion: Policy schema/default/protected-value predicate is checked by JSON escape, formatted literal, and external policy/protected-value receipts.

AC-010.assertion: Overlap and sensitive-header predicate is checked by formatted-phone, leading-zero/lossy numeric rejection, and SQLite CHECK literal cases plus external overlap/header verify receipts.

AC-011.assertion: Encoding and normalization predicate is checked by Unicode NFD JSON/text, UTF-8 BOM text, and JSON unicode-escape Battle cases plus external encoding failure receipts.

AC-012.assertion: Subject identity coherence predicate is checked by cross-format same-identity and formatted-phone cases replayed through functional Judge evidence.

AC-013.assertion: Docker self-containment predicate is proven by external docker build/mounted-run receipts; Battle maps to baseline mounted target cases after Docker image execution.

AC-014.assertion: Bare-demo workload/telemetry predicate is proven by external Docker demo receipt; Battle maps to all four baseline formats as the same image-under-test.

AC-015.assertion: Mounted output-tree boundary predicate is proven by external Docker brief-contract receipt and Battle baseline case execution against mounted input/output.

AC-016.assertion: SUBMISSION.md production-design predicate is a document gate proven by external verify/cloud-design receipts; Battle keeps one baseline case as digest-bound target linkage only.

AC-017.assertion: Repository-contained diagram predicate is a document gate proven by external diagram-consistency receipts; Battle keeps sqlite-check-literal linkage to the release-safety boundary.

non_battle_requirements.AC-004: Protected-value preservation requires docker_brief_contract.log / verify.log protected-value proof.
non_battle_requirements.AC-006: Complete-corpus release verification requires docker_brief_contract.log and spec_derived_check.json.
non_battle_requirements.AC-007: Raw-input/mapping/quarantine release-boundary proof requires release-boundary-scan.json or equivalent external receipt.
non_battle_requirements.AC-009: Policy schema/default/protected-value behavior requires verify.log and docker_brief_contract.log.
non_battle_requirements.AC-013: Docker self-containment requires docker_brief_contract.log build and mounted-run proof.
non_battle_requirements.AC-014: Bare demo telemetry requires demo.stdout.json / docker_brief_contract.log proof.
non_battle_requirements.AC-015: Mounted output tree requires docker_brief_contract.log output-tree assertion.
non_battle_requirements.AC-016: Production design requires cloud-design-check.json or equivalent document gate.
non_battle_requirements.AC-017: Flow diagram requires diagram-consistency-check.json or equivalent document gate.
